rental_restrictions.source: MLS listing data; Laketown Wharf resort documentation
rental_restrictions.evidence: No rental restrictions found. Listing confirms property generates documented STR income. Laketown Wharf is an established vacation rental resort community designed for STR use. No minimum lease term restrictions identified.

str_restrictions.evidence: STRs are legal throughout Panama City Beach with proper permits. Required permits: (1) Florida DBPR vacation rental license, (2) Panama City Beach Vacation Rental Certificate per Ordinance 1632, (3) City Business Tax Receipt, (4) Bay County TDT registration. No owner-occupancy requirement, no night caps, no minimum-stay limits (Florida preempts local restrictions). Laketown Wharf is in an established STR zone.
